name: @w6w-apps/metricool
description: Manage Metricool brands, schedule and edit social posts, and read analytics and competitor data.

w6w.longDescription:
Metricool is a social media management platform: one place to plan and publish posts across networks and to read how each brand's accounts perform.

This app lists your brands, then schedules, updates, reschedules, reads and deletes a brand's scheduled posts; reads a brand's metrics as a time series, a single total or a distribution for networks such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, Twitch and Google Business Profile; lists published posts with their metrics and popular hashtags; and tracks competitors.

A connection holds your Metricool user token and user id. Each brand-scoped action takes the brand's blogId, which List Brands returns. API access requires a Metricool plan that includes it.
